name: myanmar-buildings-overture-maps-export
notes: The Overture Maps buildings dataset describes human-made structures with roofs or interior spaces that are permanently or semi-permanently in one place. Resources split by [administrative level 1](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-mmr).
